Swap routing

Metis is the routing engine of Jupiter\'s v1 Swap API. This phone asks it directly for a quote and an unsigned transaction, sending the two tokens, the amount and your public wallet address. This phone then checks the transaction, and your wallet signs it. Metis is not Jupiter Ultra, and a swap here is not the same as trading on jup.ag.

This build adds a SAC service fee of %1$s, taken from what you receive, on pairs it has a verified fee account for. Otherwise no service fee is charged, and the review says which applies. Network, priority and pool fees are separate.
This build adds no SAC service fee. That does not make swaps free: network, priority and pool fees still apply.
The signal\'s publisher is not Jupiter, and neither Jupiter nor the publisher endorses this app.

Prediction market
Orders are placed on Jupiter Prediction, on Solana mainnet, with real funds. There is no test network for it. The market itself comes from the source the signal names.

Jupiter charges its own trading fee, included in the quoted cost, and the network charges for the transaction. SAC adds no fee to prediction orders. Jupiter\'s minimum order is currently $5, which it may change.
Jupiter Prediction is not available everywhere: Jupiter currently restricts some regions, including the United States and South Korea.

Dismissing a signal spends nothing. Approving submits an order, which may fill fully, partly or not at all. A filled position cannot be cancelled for a refund: while its market is open you can sell it at the current bid, which may be a loss, or hold it until the market settles.
